Watson redemption arc: 3-1 record despite being written off all offseason — Cleveland has more wins than Chargers, Texans, Rams, Patriots, Bucs, Titans, Dolphins COMBINED per StatMuse. Dramatic sequence: Rodgers threw Hail Mary TD to tie, taunted Cleveland crowd, then Browns kicked game-winner 10 seconds later per HaterReport. Rodgers' first QB sneak since Week 18 of 2022 (last game with Packers) per BillBarnwell. Steelers dysfunction: TJ Watt grabbed headset and cussed out defensive coordinator per HaterReport.
